# Plan Your Visit

## Current Hours

Monday: Closed  
Tuesday through Friday: 10 a.m.–5 p.m.  
Saturday and Sunday: 12 noon–5 p.m.  
**Closed** during observed College holidays (Martin Luther King Day, Memorial Day, and Labor Day); as well as July 4, 2026; November 23–27, 2026; and December 20, 2026–January 4, 2027.

## Group Visits

If you’re planning to bring a group to the Museum, we ask that you request a day/time in advance via our Public Class/Group Visit Request Form. This will ensure that all necessary staff are apprised of your request, and that we’re fully prepared to accommodate your visit.

[K–12 School - Request a group visit](https://midd.art/k-12-visit-request)

[General Public - Request a group visit](https://midd.art/public-group-visit-request)

## Accessibility

The Museum is physically accessible. Automatic doors are located directly adjacent to the museum’s main eastern entrance on the rear plaza of the Mahaney Center for the Arts as well as on the north end of the building and the western entrance facing Route 30.

- A wheelchair is available upon request.
- Assisted listening systems are available for gallery talks and can be requested at the reception desk.
- Visitors who are deaf or hard-of-hearing please call TTY (802) 443-3155.

For further accessibility information, please call (802) 443-5007.

## Location and Directions

Middlebury College is located in the town of Middlebury, midway between Rutland and Burlington, Vermont, at the intersections of Vermont Routes 7, 30, and 125. The museum is in the Mahaney Arts Center on the southeastern edge of the Middlebury College Campus. Our physical address is 72 Porter Field Road.

## Parking

Free parking is available in the Mahaney Arts Center parking lot behind the building, accessible from Route 30.

![map rendering showing the museum within the landscape of the southeastern portion of the Middlebury campus](/museum/sites/default/files/styles/1136x639/public/2025-10/museum_campus_map_002.jpg?fv=4n8-Ib0M&itok=Mgrm1E8x)

## Admission

Admission to the museum is free of charge.

For additional travel information please check the Middlebury [campus information](https://www.middlebury.edu/office/about/vermont-campus-information) with links to maps, lodging, and transportation options.
